# PrimeTech Digital Solutions (Full Context & Knowledge Base)

> Comprehensive data and documentation for AI search engines, answer engines (AEO), and LLM crawlers (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Google Gemini, Claude, Copilot).

## Overview
PrimeTech Digital Solutions is a premier web development and software engineering firm based in Vadodara, Gujarat, India. PrimeTech builds custom business websites, enterprise web applications, and delivers industry internships. Projects are completed and deployed within 15 days with starting prices at ₹4,999 INR.

## Detailed Offerings
1. **Business Websites**: Starting from ₹4,999. Tailored for startups, SMEs, and local enterprises in Gujarat to convert visitors into clients. Built with SEO metadata, structured schema, and blazing fast mobile responsiveness.
2. **Custom Web Applications**: Built with modern architectures (REST APIs, cloud databases, dynamic dashboards, and SaaS logic).
3. **Website Maintenance**: Security patch updates, speed audits, daily cloud backups, and uptime guarantee.
4. **Developer Internships**: Hands-on commercial agency experience in web development for college students in Vadodara.
